status: deterministic measurement-design target; not a statistical power calculation
interpretation: At 90 mK, localizing the heat-profile peak to +/-2 mT or better restores a common W95 field across the retained anchor, mapping, and asymmetric-width envelope.  A 4 mT no-fit sweep across the full predicted peak support meets that discretization target.
limitations: The sweep spacing controls discretization error only; instrument field calibration and heat/entropy uncertainty must also be below the target.
A smooth peak fit could use fewer points, but its guarantee would depend on the chosen line shape.
The target applies to the declared deformation envelope and does not replace a full ADR cycle measurement.
